headline: Mooring County Surges; Multiple Fronts Flare
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the Mooring County sector has erupted, with Colonial and Warden losses now climbing past 1,000 and 900 per hour respectively and nine base‑change events recorded in the past two hours. Callum’s Cape, previously described as cooling, has reversed course; hourly casualties have jumped to roughly 920 Colonial and 900 Warden, and the two‑hour window shows continued acceleration. Linn Mercy remains hotly contested, logging eight events in the last two hours and a sharp rise in both casualty streams. Weathered Expanse likewise sustains a fierce tempo, adding thirteen events in two hours and accelerating losses on both sides. Marban Hollow stays largely quiet, registering only a single event in six hours and modest, steady casualties. Stlican Shelf’s earlier spike has faded, showing no fresh flips and steady, low loss rates. Stonecradle reports a modest uptick in casualties and nine events over the day, but no recent base changes. Meanwhile, the massive meat‑grinder at Callahan’s Passage continues to bleed both factions heavily yet records no ownership shifts, while the majority of rear‑area hexes report negligible activity.
